**[07:11:52.930] Senator Mark A. Villar** (asr-007695)  
Thank you.

**[07:11:53.990] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007696)  
Yes, Mr. Chair.

**[07:11:55.230] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007697)  
Allow me to answer that question.

**[07:11:57.690] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007698)  
Since I'm the General Counsel of BSP, and under me, under the Office of the General Counsel,

**[07:12:02.670] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007699)  
under the direct supervision of the General Counsel, is the CAPO, the unit that was created

**[07:12:08.250] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007700)  
pursuant to the AFASA, so that's the Consumer Account Protection Office.

**[07:12:12.510] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007701)  
And to respond to your question, Mr. Chair, Your Honor,

**[07:12:16.150] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007702)  
it helped, it was a big help for AFASA, if you ask us at BSP, in enforcing anti-scam and fraud.

**[07:12:26.410] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007703)  
In fact, in terms of the...

**[07:12:30.790] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007704)  
You know,

**[07:12:32.190] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007705)  
accomplishments that have been done,

**[07:12:34.610] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007706)  
in our efforts to implement the AFASA,

**[07:12:38.750] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007707)  
there are already cases of finiles

**[07:12:42.430] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007708)  
against, you know, scammers.

**[07:12:47.850] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007709)  
In fact, we've been coordinating with law enforcement agencies,

**[07:12:52.770] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007710)  
and through our collaborative efforts,

**[07:12:58.150] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007711)  
we're able to, you know, the bar use or several law enforcement,

**[07:13:02.190] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007712)  
agencies were able to file cases.

**[07:13:04.650] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007713)  
I know in December 2024, for example, the NBI, the National Bureau of Investigation,

**[07:13:11.170] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007714)  
arrested seven Chinese nationals involved in an online scamming operation in Paranaque

**[07:13:16.630] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007715)  
for offenses that included social engineering schemes under AFASA.

**[07:13:21.610] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007716)  
The PNP, the Philippine National Police Anti-Cybercrime Group, or ACG,

**[07:13:26.110] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007717)  
also reported 527 AFASA-related cases in 2020,

**[07:13:32.190] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007718)  
of which 447 had already been solved or cleared,

**[07:13:37.870] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007719)  
and noted a decline in online scam incidents during the first half of 2026,

**[07:13:43.430] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007720)  
which is partly attributed to increased public awareness of fraudulent schemes.

**[07:13:48.970] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007721)  
And then,

**[07:13:49.990] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007722)  
to further increase these accomplishments,

**[07:13:59.190] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007723)  
Mr. Chair, Your Honor,

**[07:14:02.190] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007724)  
we at the BSP, again, through the CAPO,

**[07:14:07.250] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007725)  
we have actually entered into information-sharing agreements

**[07:14:13.410] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007726)  
with different government agencies or law enforcement agencies

**[07:14:17.910] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007727)  
like the SEC, the CICC, and the Department of Justice in this year, 2026.

**[07:14:26.430] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007728)  
Our invitation there, Mr. Chair, is, again,

**[07:14:29.690] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007729)  
again, thank you for the effort.

**[07:14:32.190] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007730)  
Thank you for the efforts of the sponsors, the senators who sponsored this AFASA bill.

**[07:14:37.570] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007731)  
One thing that we are able to do now because of the AFASA

**[07:14:40.990] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007732)  
is that CAPO is able to look into the bank accounts of these scammers and fraudsters

**[07:14:49.790] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007733)  
that previously were not able to do.

**[07:14:52.630] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007734)  
We don't need a court order to be able to do that.

**[07:14:55.950] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007735)  
And because of these additional powers and functions given to us,

**[07:15:00.000] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007736)  
Nakakapag-share po kami ngayon ng mga information na maaring magamit ng mga law enforcement agencies sa paghabol po dito sa mga fraudsters and scammers.

**[07:15:10.640] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007737)  
And of course, more importantly, tumaas po yung probability na ma-recover po ng mga biktima ng fraud at scam yung perang nawala po sa kanila.

**[07:15:20.020] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007738)  
So ginagawa po namin itong ISA, Information Sharing Agreement, as I said, with the different law enforcement agencies and other government agencies

**[07:15:27.540] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007739)  
para po rin masigurado na kung ano man yung information na makuha namin at i-share sa kanila ay hindi po na-abuso at nagagamit lamang po sa tamang paraan.

**[07:15:38.300] BSP General Counsel Roberto L. Figueroa** (asr-007740)  
Kaya again, as I said, to respond to your question, malaki pong naitulong at marami pong salamat doon po sa pagpasa po ng batas na iyon.

**[07:15:47.080] Senator Mark A. Villar** (asr-007741)  
Maraming salamat at nakakatuwa.

**[07:15:48.880] Senator Risa Hontiveros** (asr-007742)  
Mr. Chair, with the permission of Senator Mark.

**[07:16:24.020] Senator Risa Hontiveros** (asr-007749)

**[07:33:40.200] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007967)  
Your Honor, if I may put forward

**[07:33:43.600] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007968)  
what my observations are

**[07:33:45.840] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007969)  
on this matter that you brought up.

**[07:33:49.400] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007970)  
I think the problem lies in

**[07:33:51.860] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007971)  
when the macroeconomic assumptions are made,

**[07:33:55.380] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007972)  
which are generally made a year and a half

**[07:33:57.880] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007973)  
or a year before the actual year.

**[07:34:01.700] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007974)  
They're generally optimistic.

**[07:34:04.620] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007975)  
And all the revenue collection numbers

**[07:34:07.200] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007976)  
are based on those macroeconomic assumptions.

**[07:34:11.520] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007977)  
However, the problem in the last three years,

**[07:34:15.040] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007978)  
if you will,

**[07:34:15.940] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007979)  
is that we've been subjected

**[07:34:17.560] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007980)  
to so many unpredictable external shocks,

**[07:34:21.840] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007981)  
such as the war in Ukraine,

**[07:34:25.280] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007982)  
such as the United States'

**[07:34:27.880] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007983)  
reciprocal tariffs,

**[07:34:30.380] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007984)  
and now the war in Iran.

**[07:34:33.140] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007985)  
So I think the dilemma is

**[07:34:36.080] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007986)  
when the macroeconomic assumptions are made,

**[07:34:40.100] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007987)  
they're made without the ability

**[07:34:44.380] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007988)  
to predict such black swan events

**[07:34:48.860] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007989)  
or such global external shocks

**[07:34:53.880] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007990)  
that are beyond our control.

**[07:34:55.760] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007991)  
So what happens is when you compare

**[07:34:57.740] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007992)  
the actual revenue collection

**[07:34:59.520] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007993)  
versus the macroeconomic assumptions

**[07:35:04.740] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007994)  
made a year and a half ago,

**[07:35:08.580] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007995)  
they are not able to take into account

**[07:35:12.160] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007996)  
these eventualities.

**[07:35:15.260] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007997)  
So a case in point, for example,

**[07:35:17.240] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007998)  
is the budget of 2025

**[07:35:20.800] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-007999)  
was made in June 2024.

**[07:35:24.820] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008000)  
And after the...

**[07:35:27.740] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008001)  
the flood control investigations, for example,

**[07:35:30.580] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008002)  
suddenly the public sector spending suddenly dropped.

**[07:35:34.540] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008003)  
So the GDP growth of the country suffers.

**[07:35:41.240] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008004)  
And unfortunately,

**[07:35:42.880] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008005)  
the collection targets were set a year before that.

**[07:35:46.840] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008006)  
So I think that's generally my observation on this matter.

**[07:35:54.000] Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian** (asr-008007)  
Don't you and the DBCC also meet regularly?

**[07:35:57.740] Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian** (asr-008008)

**[07:36:00.140] Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian** (asr-008009)

**[07:36:00.620] Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian** (asr-008010)

**[07:36:06.420] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008012)

**[07:36:07.500] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008013)  
So the macroeconomic numbers,

**[07:36:09.320] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008014)  
assumptions change every six months.

**[07:36:12.040] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008015)

**[07:36:18.860] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008016)  
So if your question, your honor,

**[07:36:20.840] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008017)  
is about the fiscal deficit,

**[07:36:24.080] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008018)  
the NEP for 20...

**[07:36:26.960] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-008020)  
Only the...

**[07:36:29.600] Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian** (asr-008024)  
For collection.

**[07:36:30.660] Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian** (asr-008025)

what I wanted to explain was

**[08:26:57.440] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009052)

**[08:27:02.100] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009053)

**[08:27:08.800] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009054)

**[08:27:33.360] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009055)

**[08:27:39.340] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009057)

**[08:27:42.780] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009058)

**[08:27:45.820] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009059)

Yes.

**[08:28:01.260] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009062)

**[08:28:07.800] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009063)

**[08:28:08.800] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009064)

**[08:28:11.880] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009065)

**[08:28:25.260] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009066)

**[08:28:35.340] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009067)

**[08:28:38.800] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009068)

**[08:28:56.360] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009070)

**[08:29:02.680] DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go** (asr-009071)  
Because there's a gray area in the ports of...

**[08:30:07.300] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009082)

**[08:30:17.580] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009085)

**[08:30:23.480] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009086)

**[08:30:42.000] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009088)

**[08:30:45.080] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009089)

**[08:30:58.140] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009090)  
And this is the problem.

**[08:31:00.000] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009091)

**[08:31:08.140] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009092)  
Do we know, for example, that because we don't have a national land use,

**[08:31:15.020] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009093)

**[08:31:23.940] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009094)

**[08:31:26.000] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009095)

**[08:31:35.500] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009097)

**[08:31:40.960] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009098)  
Or we lost 3.4 million hectares of land.

**[08:31:45.920] Senator Risa Hontiveros** (asr-009099)  
Conversion po.

**[08:31:47.180] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009100)

**[08:31:49.740] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009101)  
Now, rice.

**[08:31:54.180] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009102)  
Out of that 6.3 million,

**[08:32:00.000] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009103)

**[08:32:08.200] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009104)

**[08:32:11.060] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009105)  
But only 1.84 million of that is irrigated.

**[08:32:17.260] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009106)  
All right.

**[08:32:18.080] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009107)  
In the last 15 years,

**[08:32:20.740] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009108)  
it's almost exactly the same amount at the same level of irrigation.

**[08:32:27.960] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009109)  
There you are.

**[08:32:28.700] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009110)  
You have 20.

**[08:32:29.220] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009111)  
You have lost our land,

**[08:32:31.080] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009112)  
and for those remaining land,

**[08:32:33.160] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009113)

**[08:32:39.940] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009114)  
Now, rice production in the last 10 years grew by only 0.9% every year.

**[08:32:48.130] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009115)  
Our population is growing at 1.23% average per year.

**[08:32:57.490] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009116)  
So, by the increase,

**[08:33:00.470] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009117)  
the population,

**[08:33:01.670] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009118)  
kulang na kulang yung,

**[08:33:03.290] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009119)  
ina-outpace na yung rice production.

**[08:33:08.730] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009120)  
So, are we surprised why we are importing so much?

**[08:33:14.770] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009121)  
We should not be surprised

**[08:33:16.310] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009122)  
because of that situation

**[08:33:23.130] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009123)  
where we have allowed our very productive farms

**[08:33:28.970] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009124)  
to be converted into non-use,

**[08:33:32.550] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009125)  
and you can think,

**[08:33:33.790] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009126)  
you can go around,

**[08:33:34.990] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009127)  
travel to the south,

**[08:33:36.210] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009128)  
to the north,

**[08:33:37.190] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009129)  
you see irrigated lands being converted into,

**[08:33:44.970] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009130)  
and that's something that you cannot see

**[08:33:46.770] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009131)

**[08:33:49.650] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009132)

**[08:33:51.710] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009133)

**[08:33:54.630] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009134)

**[08:33:57.430] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009135)  
into non-traditional use.

**[08:34:02.550] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009136)  
Non-agricultural uses.

**[08:34:05.750] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009137)  
So, it's that,

**[08:34:07.570] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009138)  
Madam Chair,

**[08:34:08.050] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009139)  
if you are looking for the root problem

**[08:34:11.170] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009140)  
of our incapacity to produce enough food

**[08:34:14.950] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009141)

**[08:34:18.250] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009142)

**[08:34:19.350] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009143)  
We haven't made our farmlands more productive

**[08:34:22.750] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009144)

**[08:34:27.230] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009145)

**[08:34:28.030] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009146)  
And we haven't passed a national land use code

**[08:34:32.550] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009147)

**[08:34:34.690] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009148)

**[08:34:43.090] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009149)  
And I appeal that

**[08:34:44.250] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009150)

**[08:34:49.450] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009151)

**[08:34:53.590] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009152)

**[08:34:54.850] DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan** (asr-009153)  
that has been languishing for the last 25 years.
